description:
The Addison Chest Dresser has six dovetailed drawers with full-extension glides, and the drawers come in two sizes. It is made with a solid hardwood frame.

It measures 41 inches wide, 50 inches high, and 21 inches deep, and it coordinates with the complete Addison collection.
title: Addison Chest Dresser
metaDescription: The Addison Chest Dresser has six dovetailed drawers with full-extension glides and a solid hardwood frame.
